name: Squash, stretch & anticipation
oneLiner: Every sprite the game already draws gets procedural squash and stretch about its feet, with no new frames: a crouch before jumps, swings and spells, a stretch while rising and falling fast, a squash on landing and on taking a hit, a damped spring back with overshoot, a lean into movement and a slow breath at rest. Area is kept (sx*sy = 1); it is a canvas transform around the sprite draw only, so hit boxes, timing and rules never change. Deterministic from game time; whole-pixel snapping for pixel games, smooth for HD.
fits: turn-based or tactics battles (attack and hit poses)
any game with sprites drawn by drawImage or canvas paths
notFor: games that draw characters as tiles baked into a tilemap (no per-sprite draw call to wrap)
3D or WebGL-rendered characters (this is a 2D canvas transform)
games whose collision is pixel-perfect against the drawn sprite (read back from the canvas): the drawn shape changes
rigidly realistic styles where cartoon deformation reads as wrong (use amount 0.3-0.5)

needs: a fixed update step that calls update(dt) once per step (also run by ?t= fast-forward and ?auto=1)
each moving actor's velocity and on-ground flag per step (motion), any units, with maxSpeed / maxFall in the same units
optional hit event: accepted damage with the blow's direction (squash and tilt away)
optional attack / cast start and long wind-ups (anticipation, charge / release)
the per-actor sprite draw call, wrapped by wrap(ctx, id, footX, footY, fn) with the feet point in draw coordinates
provides: deformation of each wrapped sprite about its feet (sy, sx = 1/sy, shear)
automatic land / take-off detection from motion()
transform(id) for shadows that widen with the squash
stats(): events by kind, auto land / jump, deepest squash, tallest stretch, strongest lean, volume error, open saves (for tests)

assets: module/squash-stretch.js: the element as one dependency-free script (global GameDNA_SquashStretch): per-actor springs on a volume-preserving scale and a shear, scripted anticipation / hold / charge poses, auto land and take-off from velocity, whole-pixel snapping, apply/restore/wrap about the feet; skins only suggest snapping (motion.snap) and squash depth (motion.squash)
no image or audio files (the demo's three characters are painted once in code, original)

module.skin: optional: skins/skin-api.js + a skin before it (pixel skins turn snapping on)
